.. py:data:: MaskMethod

.. py:class:: MaskHemodynamicsResult

   PI/RI (and optional flow) result for one label, from a mask-based hemodynamics computation.


   .. py:attribute:: method
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label_id
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: pi
      :type:  float


   .. py:attribute:: ri
      :type:  float


   .. py:attribute:: mean_velocity_mm_s
      :type:  float | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: mean_flow_ml_s
      :type:  float | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: cross_section_area_mm2
      :type:  float | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: note
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



.. py:function:: mask_voxel_averaged_hemodynamics(mask: numpy.ndarray, ap: numpy.ndarray, rl: numpy.ndarray, fh: numpy.ndarray, *, label_id: int = 1) -> MaskHemodynamicsResult

   Velocity-only PI/RI from mean through-plane velocity along PCA axis.

   No cross-sectional area; not interchangeable with catheter-style flow.


.. py:function:: mask_pseudo_loc_hemodynamics(mask: numpy.ndarray, ap: numpy.ndarray, rl: numpy.ndarray, fh: numpy.ndarray, *, mag: numpy.ndarray, cd: numpy.ndarray, vel_mag: numpy.ndarray, label_id: int = 1, voxel_spacing: tuple[float, float, float] = (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), radius_vox: float = 10.0, measure_resegment: bool = True, thr_algorithm: nvitk.measure.cross_section.ThrAlgorithm = 'lsthr', cross_section_res: int = 0, plane_interp_order: int = 1, volume_seg: numpy.ndarray | None = None) -> MaskHemodynamicsResult

   Pseudo-LOC at mid-centerline station with oblique cross-section flow.


.. py:function:: measure_mask_hemodynamics(mask: numpy.ndarray, ap: numpy.ndarray, rl: numpy.ndarray, fh: numpy.ndarray, *, mag: numpy.ndarray | None = None, cd: numpy.ndarray | None = None, vel_mag: numpy.ndarray | None = None, label_id: int = 1, method: MaskMethod = 'both', voxel_spacing: tuple[float, float, float] = (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), radius_vox: float = 10.0, measure_resegment: bool = True, thr_algorithm: nvitk.measure.cross_section.ThrAlgorithm = 'lsthr', volume_seg: numpy.ndarray | None = None) -> list[MaskHemodynamicsResult]

   Run one or both mask hemodynamic methods for *label_id*.
